info.title: Corpotex API
info.description: Supplier and workshop management with a WhatsApp agent.

get.description:
Open alerts. `?mine=1` keeps only the ones that concern the caller's role, with the same
rule the assistant uses to notify (ADR 0020). `?status=` filters; default `open`.

post.description:
Does not revoke the token: in the demo the same user has two windows open, and a
revocation would log the other one out. The client just forgets the token.

get.description:
Read-only chat for the simulator and the purchase order detail (manager only: supplier
messages may carry prices).

post.description: Idempotent: the same action again returns 200 with the current state; a different one, 409.

get.description:
`GET /api/materials/`: every material ordered by kind and name; `?kind=`, `?q=` (sku or name). `committed` is the sum of
`Requirement.qty_from_stock` of open orders; `available = stock - committed`.
`GET /api/materials/<id>/`: the list row plus the open orders that take from it.
Counters for the menu and the assistant button, polled every 5 s (ADR 0020, 0022).

Everything the Monitor page shows, in one call. Shape agreed with `disenador`
(frontend/mocks/monitor.json); manager-only parts are `null` for the other roles.

post.description: Register an order (sales or manager). Idempotent by `code`: 201 when new, 200 when it existed.

get.description:
The workshop's public page (`/report/<token>`): no login, the token is the secret.
Never prices nor the supplier (ADR 0024 C).

get.description:
`GET /api/requirements/pending/`: open material requirements grouped by material, the
"Por pedir" screen (ADR 0025 A). Manager and production; prices only for the manager.

`GET /api/routes/`: all routes (`?date=`, `?status=`), or with `?current=1` the pair
`{current, replaced}` the map shows (ADR 0024).
Any route in any status: the scene opens `before` and `after` side by side.

post.description: `POST /api/routes/plan/ {date}` (manager and production): plans or re-plans that day.

Alert.description:
Adds `<field>_display` for every choice field listed in `Meta.display_fields` (declared
as real fields so the OpenAPI schema carries them), and strips manager-only fields from
every nested payload when the context role is not the manager (nested serializers do not
go through `serializer_for`).
